evidence.title: DICS: Data-Informed Centroid Splitting for Decision Tree Classifiers

summary: A new technique called Data-Informed Centroid Splitting (DICS) improves decision‑tree classifiers by using centroid information to guide split decisions. Tests on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate increased accuracy and more balanced tree structures compared with traditional splitting methods.
title: Researchers Introduce DICS Method to Enhance Decision Tree Splitting via Data-Informed Centroids
